content.text: the warnings as well as the promises.","ref":"Lamentations 2:17"}]},"talk":{"title":"Keep Hoping in Jehovah","summary":"The talk shows how Jeremiah, though grieving, kept trusting that Jehovah would show mercy again.","points":[{"text":"Jerusalem’s fall was hard, but it wasn’t the end of Jehovah’s care.","ref":"Lamentations 1:1"},{"text":"Honest prayer helps us carry grief.","ref":""}],"jehovah":[{"text":"He feels for his people when they suffer.","ref":""}]},"spiritual_gems":{"summary":"Short comments you could give, in your own words, each pointing to the verse it’s about.","comments":[{"text":"Even in deep sorrow, Jeremiah didn’t blame Jehovah; he spoke to him honestly.","ref":"Lamentations 2:11"},{"text":"A whole book of sad songs shows that Jehovah makes room for grief.","ref":"Lamentations 1:16"},{"text":"I can tell Jehovah exactly how I feel, as Jeremiah did.","ref":"Lamentations 2:19"}]},"bible_reading":{"reading":"Lamentations 1–2","summary":"Jeremiah mourns Jerusalem after its destruction, picturing the city as a widow left alone.","happens":[{"text":"Jerusalem lies empty; its people are gone and its enemies mock it.","ref":"Lamentations 1:1-7"},{"text":"Jeremiah weeps and calls on the people to cry out to Jehovah.","ref":"Lamentations 2:18, 19"}],"teaches":[{"text":"He keeps his word, the warnings as well as the promises.","ref":"Lamentations 2:17"}],"apply":[{"text":"Tell Jehovah how we really feel, as Jeremiah did.","ref":""},{"text":"Take his warnings seriously while there is time.","ref":""}]}}
